cat components/BaseRow/hooks/useRowContent.js | head -80; cat components/BaseGroupHeader/BaseGroupHeader.css; grep -rn "ColumnReorderingContext\|useSortable\|useDraggable" components/BaseHeaderRow/*.js components/BaseHeaderCell/*.js | head
cat components/BaseRow/utils/getRowContent.js | head -60

sed -n 1,80p components/BaseHeaderRow/BaseHeaderRow.js; cat utils/getToggleAllEnabledRowsSelectedHandler.js 2>/dev/null; grep -rn "meta\.\|enableReordering\|enableColumnReordering\|canDrag\|disabled" components/ColumnReorderingProvider/*.js components/BaseDraggableHeaderCell/*.js | head -20; cat types/base.d.ts | head -80
sed -n 20,120p components/ColumnReorderingProvider/ColumnReorderingProvider.js; cat components/BaseHeaderRow/utils/getCanReorderHeader.js

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation && ls build/esm 2>/dev/null | head; find build -name "types.d.ts" -path "*AsideHeader*" | head; grep -n -A40 "^## \|AsideHeader" README.md | sed -n 1,120p
cat build/esm/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts | head -120; ls build/docs; grep -n "MenuItem\b\|export interface MenuItem\|export type MenuItem" -A30 build/esm/components/types.d.ts | head -60

grep -n "interface LogoProps" -A22 build/esm/components/types.d.ts; grep -rn "RenderContentType" -A4 build/esm/components/Content/*.d.ts | head; ls /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | grep -E "^(House|Persons|ShoppingCart|Gear|Box|LayoutSideContent|Cubes3)\.js"

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm && grep -n "selected\|group-header\|interactive" components/Table/Table.css components/BaseTable/BaseTable.css | head -30; cat hooks/useToggleRangeSelectionHandler.js | head -60; cat components/SelectionCheckbox/SelectionCheckbox.d.ts
cat components/Table/types.d.ts components/BaseCell/BaseCell.d.ts | head -50; grep -n "getIsPlaceholder\|getIsAggregated" -r components | head; sed -n 1,60p components/Table/Table.css

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npm install @gravity-ui/icons@^2.16.0 @bem-react/classname@^1.7.0 lodash@^4.17.21 @gravity-ui/i18n@^1.8.0 2>&1 | grep -v allow-scripts | tail -3; npm ls --depth=0 2>&1 | tail -20
npm uninstall @dnd-kit/utilities 2>&1 | grep -v allow-scripts | tail -1; grep -n "MenuItem\b" node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/index.d.ts | head -3; npm run build 2>&1 | tail -30

grep -n "MenuItem\|AsideHeaderItem" node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/types.d.ts | head; head -30 node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/index.d.ts

which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; npx --no-install playwright --version 2>&1 | head -2; ls /home/sandbox/workspace/__agent_eval__
mkdir -p /tmp/pw && cd /tmp/pw && npm init -y >/dev/null && npm install playwright@1.56.1 2>&1 | grep -v allow-scripts | tail -2 && npx playwright install --with-deps chromium 2>&1 | tail -3
cd /tmp/pw && npx playwright install chromium 2>&1 | tail -3; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright

mkdir -p /tmp/pwlibs/debs && cd /tmp/pwlibs/debs && cat /etc/os-release | head -3; timeout 120 apt-get download libnss3 libnspr4 libdbus-1-3 libatk1.0-0 libatk-bridge2.0-0 libatspi2.0-0 libxcomposite1 libxdamage1 libxfixes3 libxrandr2 libgbm1 libxkbcommon0 libasound2 libcups2 libdrm2 libwayland-server0 libxshmfence1 libpango-1.0-0 libcairo2 2>&1 | tail -5; ls | wc -l

cd /tmp/pwlibs/debs && timeout 120 apt-get download libglib2.0-0 libxi6 libxrender1 libx11-6 libxcb1 libxext6 libxau6 libxdmcp6 libexpat1 libfontconfig1 libfreetype6 libpng16-16 libffi8 libpcre2-8-0 libmount1 libselinux1 libblkid1 libbsd0 libmd0 libharfbuzz0b libfribidi0 libthai0 libdatrie1 libgraphite2-3 libpixman-1-0 libxcb-render0 libxcb-shm0 libbrotli1 libavahi-common3 libavahi-client3 libgnutls30 libwayland-client0 fonts-dejavu-core 2>&1 | tail -1; cd /tmp/pwlibs && for d in debs/*.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$d" root; done; find /tmp/pwlibs/root -name "*.so*" -printf '%h\n' | sort -u | tr '\n' ':' > /tmp/pwlibs/path; cd /tmp/pw && LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$(cat /tmp/pwlibs/path) FONTCONFIG_PATH=/tmp/pwlibs/root/etc/fonts node smoke.mjs 2>&1 | tail -15

cd /tmp/pwlibs/debs && timeout 120 apt-get download libsqlite3-0 2>&1 | tail -1; cd /tmp/pwlibs && dpkg-deb -x debs/libsqlite3-0*.deb root; find /tmp/pwlibs/root -name "*.so*" -printf '%h\n' | sort -u | tr '\n' ':' > /tmp/pwlibs/path; cd /tmp/pw && LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$(cat /tmp/pwlibs/path) FONTCONFIG_PATH=/tmp/pwlibs/root/etc/fonts node smoke.mjs 2>&1 | tail -15
